commit_message:
[Merged] Fix a crash in the fts3aux code that could occur handling corrupt records.

FossilOrigin-Name: cdcd65b89ecffd380483404f5b1379beffd7ff107acaa5bc1185651cfacaa220
pr_title: Guard FTS3 auxiliary statistics against corrupt column indexes
pr_description:
Validate column indexes read from FTS3 records before growing the auxiliary statistics array. Require indexes to be between 1 and 0x3fffffff so corrupt records cannot overflow the iCol+2 size calculation.

Validation: git diff --check passed, and the PR state applies cleanly against the base revision.

             eState = 3;
           }else{            /* 2 or greater. A position. */
             pCsr->aStat[iCol+1].nOcc++;
             pCsr->aStat[0].nOcc++;
           }
           break;
 
         /* State 3. The integer just read is a column number. */
         default: assert( eState==3 );
           iCol = (int)v;
+          if( iCol<1 || iCol>0x3fffffff ){
+            rc = SQLITE_CORRUPT_VTAB;
+            break;
+          }

           pCsr->aStat[iCol+1].nDoc++;
           eState = 2;
           break;
       }
     }
 
     pCsr->iCol = 0;
     rc = SQLITE_OK;
   }else{

intro_commit_message:
Fix a crash in the fts3aux code that could occur handling corrupt records.

FossilOrigin-Name: cdcd65b89ecffd380483404f5b1379beffd7ff107acaa5bc1185651cfacaa220
fix_commit_message:
Prevent integer overflow due to database corruption in. fts3auxNextMethod(). [bugs:/forumpost/bce19272cf|Bug report bce19272cf].

FossilOrigin-Name: d903795e3bdf91607f23dace5a15a070139b32e34aed8540a6c2e19c39e997be
agent_reasoning: The existing lower-bound check allowed positive column indexes near INT_MAX to reach fts3auxGrowStatArray(), where iCol+2 could overflow a signed integer. The source edit adds the upstream upper bound of 0x3fffffff before array growth and indexing, preventing this overflow. Only ext/fts3/fts3_aux.c was edited; tests and Fossil metadata were left as supplied in the introductory snapshot.
